keyPoints.note: A cylinder has two circular ends and a curved surface.
A cone has a circular base and a point (apex).
Use the facts about the solid.

Net G has a 2 by 2 block of squares: four squares around one corner would need 4 faces to meet at a vertex, but only 3 can meet at a cube corner.
